The '''''Ardent''''' was a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Some time after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it attempted to aid the ''[[Inamo]]'' when it fell under attack from [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] forces who had been patiently observing a Rebel Cache . The cruiser arrived too late and the ''Inamo'' was destroyed. It launched [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] squadrons [[Tiger Squadron|Tiger]] and [[Shark Squadron (Z-95)|Shark]] to engage the TIE Avengers. It escaped a rocket attack with a badly-damaged hull, the Ardent possibly launched a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Argus (shuttle)|''Argus'']].

The event was then used in the [[Combat chamber]] as a training simulator for future TIE Avenger [[TIE pilot|pilots]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in particular.
